profile.summary: Juan C. Gomez Cruz is a Computer Engineer specializing in embedded software development. In 2013, he graduated from the University of Puerto Rico - Mayagüez Campus, and currently works for Honeywell Aerospace as a Software Engineer.

projects.title: CardioTAG
projects.description:
Portable ECG Device
Software Engineer : Firmware developer

Features:
- Gather electrical activity of the heart using 2 electrodes (1 Lead ECG)
- Wireless connection to Android device via Bluetooth
- Store data in internal SD card
- Operate unit in live mode or standalone capture mode
- View stored data or live data on Android device
- Operate on a 2,000mAh Lithium battery
